subject.title: fix(anthropic): handle max_turns stop reason and surface retry-limit details to users

question: Should Anthropic `max_turns` remain public `length` with raw `provider_stop_reason` diagnostics, rather than becoming an `error` or a new public stop reason?
rationale: The code can implement several terminal-state shapes, but the choice affects runner/session finalization and the public `StopReason` contract, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept length plus diagnostics after repair
options.body: Land once the max-turn user copy preserves unsafe-replay warnings and maintainers accept keeping the public stop reason as `length`.

options.title: Request a different terminal contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to classify `max_turns` as an error or a new public stop reason if maintainers want a stronger semantic split from output-token truncation.

options.title: Pause for stronger provider evidence
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers require live hosted Anthropic evidence before accepting defensive handling for this raw stop reason.

recommendation.title: Accept length plus diagnostics after repair
recommendation.body: Land once the max-turn user copy preserves unsafe-replay warnings and maintainers accept keeping the public stop reason as `length`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest history signal on the Anthropic stream runtime and stop-reason mapper boundary.
